python_datetime_now.tooltip: Return the current local date and time as a naive datetime object.

python_datetime_utc_now.tooltip: Return the current UTC date and time as a timezone-aware datetime object.

python_datetime_timestamp_now.tooltip: Return seconds since the POSIX epoch using the system wall clock.

python_datetime_monotonic_ms.tooltip: Return a monotonic counter in whole milliseconds for elapsed-time measurement.

python_datetime_monotonic_us.tooltip: Return a monotonic counter in whole microseconds for elapsed-time measurement.
